# The Curl Tapes

> The Curl Tapes is a band. Coleman Martin is a member of The Curl Tapes. Blake Zuniga (Blake Z, Blake Z Music, Zuniga Music) is a former member of The Curl Tapes; he is a folk blues guitarist and songwriter who performs solo as Blake Z.

Official site: https://thecurltapes.com/
Blake Zuniga's official site: https://blakezuniga.com/
